text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-d a r-i-v-a-l c-o-n-t-e-s-t in a p-u-b-l-i-c b-u-i-l-d p-r-o-c-e-s-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-e-n-d-e-r a-n-n-o-u-n-c-e m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l-s and a g-a-t-h-e-r-e-d r-i-v-a-l l-i-s-t, and this l-e-f-t a n-a-m-e-d f-o-r-u-m s-c-r-a-p as the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e the i-n-i-t-i-a-l c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s k-e-e-p i-n-t-e-r-f-a-c-e was o-v-e-r-s-e-e-n
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-t-u-p a s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g p-o-o-l with two o-t-h-e-r b-i-d-d-e-r-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t p-o-o-l and p-r-i-c-i-n-g t-a-b-l-e-s, and this l-e-f-t a j-o-i-n-t w-o-r-k-b-o-o-k a-c-c-e-s-s log as the t-r-a-c-e while the f-i-x-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g p-o-l-i-c-y was r-e-m-o-v-e-d
3) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d p-l-a-n-s and a w-i-n n-o-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d b-i-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s and a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r o-f d-e-a-d-l-i-n-e-s, and this l-e-f-t a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-r-t f-i-l-e in the g-r-o-u-p c-h-a-t while the m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e-s of a-j-o-i-n-t a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t-s were s-k-i-p-p-e-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r t-e-r-m-s the o-f-f-b-o-o-k c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n a-r-r-a-n-g-e-m-e-n-t-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-i-e-n-t-s and p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s, and this l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g the d-a-t-a b-a-s-e while the f-o-r-m-a-l f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n-s and b-a-n-k m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g was i-g-n-o-r-e-d
5) the a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d the b-i-d-s to the a-g-e-n-c-y as a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e f-i-e-l-d, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a p-o-l-i-c-y w-a-l-l and i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, and this l-e-f-t a f-o-r-m-a-l r-e-c-e-i-p-t as the t-r-a-c-e while the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the b-i-d-d-i-n-g a-g-e-n-c-y was d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d
